edges: State v. Lindsey discusses the requirement for trial courts to recite all instructions to the jury, which is a principle also referenced in State v. Foster.

multi_hop_neighbors.edge: Ho v. Carey discusses the presumption that juries follow instructions, which is a general principle in court rulings.

edges: State v. Lindsey emphasizes that failing to recite an instruction to the jury is akin to providing an erroneous instruction, a point also made in Ho v. Carey.

multi_hop_neighbors.edge: Ho v. Carey discusses the presumption that juries follow instructions, which is a general principle in court rulings.
